title: Processing- and cell-stage thermodynamic screening of nacre- and bone-inspired carbonate and phosphate phases on aluminium current collectors in fluorine-free lithium-ion cells with an open screening framework
description:
An open framework that screens candidate mineral coatings, biopolymer-templated carbonate and phosphate phases, against two thermodynamic tests: dissolution in the alkaline aqueous slurry of electrode processing, and the oxidation onset at the aluminium current collector of a lithium-ion cell. Inputs are sourced thermochemistry with propagated uncertainty; outputs are stage-resolved exclusion maps, break-even ratios, required-precision maps and the input value at which each verdict flips. The repository re-derives every number, table and data figure of the accompanying paper from the sourced parameter file and cached inputs. It does not test any coating experimentally.

Code is released under the MIT licence; data and results under CC BY 4.0. Materials Project data keep their own licence and attribution (see THIRD_PARTY.md).
